title: Derived residue homology on the localized module site
statement: For a scheme S [def-pc-scheme], an open U, a chosen derived category of modules on its localized site [def-pc-derived-category], and x in U, define localizedResidueHomology as the composite of the derived over-site equivalence to U, derived pullback to Spec kappa(x) [def-pc-derived-pullback], degree-zero derived homology, global sections and restriction of scalars along GammaSpecIso inverse. Use the standard derived localizations on U and its residue scheme. This explicitly constructed functor takes values in kappa(x)-modules [def-weil-residue-field].
